statBlock.name: Kelek
statBlock.description: Kelek founded the League of Malevolence and wants to take Ringlerun’s Staff of Power. He makes a show of ruthlessness and falls back on magic when threatened.

sections.Traits: Special Equipment. Kelek wears Bracers of Defense and starts with a fully charged Staff of Striking (10 charges). Each dawn, the staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges. When the last charge is spent, roll a d20. On a 1, it becomes an ordinary quarterstaff.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using any combination of Sorcerer’s Bolt and Staff of Striking. Kelek can cast one spell from Spellcasting in place of one attack.
Sorcerer’s Bolt. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d12) force damage.
Staff of Striking. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, or 9 (1d8 + 5) if wielded with two hands. On a hit, spend up to three charges to add 3 (1d6) force damage per charge.
Fiery Explosion (Recharge 4–6). Choose a point Kelek can see within 120 ft. The point erupts in magical fire. Every creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere around it makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. It takes 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failure, or half on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 14).
At will. Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Dominate Beast, Fly, Mirror Image, Web.
sections.Reactions: Arcane Defense (3/day). When an attack hits Kelek, an invisible barrier adds 5 to his AC through the end of his next turn. Apply the bonus to the triggering attack as well.
sections.Combat notes: Use Arcane Defense when Kelek’s low AC leaves him exposed. He uses Fiery Explosion whenever practical, even when allies are in the blast.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 219.

statBlock.name: Kettlesteam the Kenku
statBlock.description: A kenku warlock disrupts the Witchlight Carnival to learn why she lost contact with her patron Zybilna. She passes among the visitors using Disguise Self and speaks in the voice she stole from Candlefoot.

sections.Languages: Understands Auran and Common. She speaks through Mimicry.
sections.Traits: Mimicry. She can reproduce voices and any other sounds she has heard. A listener needs a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check to recognize an imitation.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Twilight Sleep (2/day). Choose one creature she can see within 10 ft. Magical gas forces a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is unconscious for 1 minute. Damage wakes it immediately, as does another creature using an action to shake or slap it awake.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 13).
At will. Disguise Self, Friends, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Bestow Curse, Faerie Fire, Speak with Animals.
sections.Encounter notes: After an hour searching the carnival, a character can see through her disguise with a successful DC 13 Intelligence (Investigation) check. She flees to break line of sight and may talk to adventurers who say they are investigating the carnival. Her pact prevents her from entering Prismeer. She presses Mister Witch and Mister Light for answers and asks adventurers to find out what happened to Zybilna. Untie the thorny stem around her cornhusk doll to restore Candlefoot’s voice. A successful DC 12 Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check persuades her to hand over the doll.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 52.

statBlock.name: Living Doll
statBlock.description: A spiteful spirit hides inside a toy or stuffed animal. The doll torments people who doubt themselves and uses laughter and psychic pain to fend off attackers.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. If the doll is motionless when combat starts, it rolls initiative with advantage. A creature that has never seen it move or act needs a successful DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize that it is animate.
Regeneration. The doll regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. Fire or psychic damage prevents this healing at the start of its next turn. It is destroyed only if it begins its turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
Unusual Nature. The doll needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions: Grabby Hands. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, one creature within reach 5 ft. A hit grapples the creature (escape DC 6). While grappled this way, the creature takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. The doll can grapple only one creature at a time.
sections.Bonus actions: Cackle (Recharge 4–6). Choose one or two creatures the doll can see within 30 ft. A target that hears the doll must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. Intelligence 4 or lower makes the save an automatic success. On a failure, it takes 5 (2d4) psychic damage and is incapacitated by laughter for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on any of those saves is immune to this doll’s Cackle for 24 hours.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 238.

statBlock.name: Mercion
statBlock.description: A protective cleric of Valor’s Call. Mercion finds beauty in truth and follows that principle in place of a deity.

sections.Armor: Plate armor. Use her printed AC 19.
sections.Traits: Special Equipment. Mercion wields a +1 Quarterstaff.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Divine Radiance attack and one +1 Quarterstaff attack. Mercion can cast one spell from Spellcasting in place of either attack.
Divine Radiance. Melee or ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 13 (3d8) radiant damage.
+1 Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack with the printed +4 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) if wielded with two hands.
Radiant Fire (Recharge 5–6). Pick a point Mercion can see within 120 ft. The point erupts in magical radiance. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere around it makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. It takes 28 (8d6) radiant damage on a failure, or half on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (save DC 13).
At will. Light, Spare the Dying.
2/day each. Command, Create Food and Water, Cure Wounds, Faerie Fire, Hold Person, Revivify.
1/day. Death Ward.
sections.Combat notes: Mercion heals from behind her armor. She uses Radiant Fire only when the blast is clear of allies and bystanders. Otherwise she favors Hold Person or Divine Radiance.
sections.Printing note: The stat block is on printed p. 225. Some indexes list p. 224. The printed stat block lists AC 19 and +4 to hit with the +1 Quarterstaff.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 225.

statBlock.name: Mister Light
statBlock.description: The flamboyant Witchlight Carnival emcee once went by Urmius Umbrage. He left a wealthy Shadowfell family to run the carnival with Mister Witch.

sections.Damage vulnerabilities: Lightning while holding the Witchlight Vane.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, deafened, petrified, stunned while attuned to the Witchlight Vane.
sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. Light has advantage on saves against being charmed. Magic cannot put him to sleep.
Special Equipment. Light carries and is attuned to the Witchlight Vane. He can wield it as a finesse weapon.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Witchlight Vane attacks.
Witchlight Vane. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
While carrying the Witchlight Vane, use an action to cast one spell with Charisma (save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). No spell components are needed.
At will. Dancing Lights, Polymorph, Ray of Frost. After casting Polymorph, roll a d8. On a 3 or 8, Light loses access to Polymorph until the next dawn.
sections.Bonus actions: Blessing of the Raven Queen (1/day). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. Light takes all worn or carried equipment with him, looks ghostly, and has resistance to all damage until the start of his next turn.
sections.Encounter notes: Light and Mister Witch want Zybilna back. Their pact gives the Hourglass Coven permission to steal from unticketed guests. Use the Witchlight Vane’s Sense Mood to find the happiest creature on the carnival grounds as an action.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 26.
sections.Printing note: Use the published +5 to hit and 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning for Light’s attack. The Witchlight Vane’s separate item entry lists a generic magic weapon bonus.

statBlock.name: Mister Witch
statBlock.description: The Witchlight Carnival’s reserved co-owner used to tend a clock tower in Gloomwrought under the name Naeryx Krumple. His pocket watch can pack up the carnival or set it in motion.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. Witch has advantage on saves against being charmed. Magic cannot put him to sleep.
Special Equipment. Witch carries and is attuned to the Witchlight Watch.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Cane attacks.
Cane. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
While carrying the Witchlight Watch, use an action to cast one spell with Intelligence (save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). No spell components are needed.
At will. Fire Bolt, Invisibility, Message. After casting Invisibility, roll a d8. On a 3 or 8, Witch loses access to Invisibility until the next dawn.
sections.Bonus actions: Blessing of the Raven Queen (1/day). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. Witch takes all worn or carried equipment with him, looks ghostly, and has resistance to all damage until the start of his next turn.
sections.Encounter notes: Witch and Mister Light keep the carnival running under the Hourglass Coven’s pact. The Witchlight Watch lets Witch start a one-hour magical setup or takedown as an action while he and the carnival are on the same plane. This moves the carnival’s objects and leaves creatures free to move safely.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 25.

statBlock.name: Molliver
statBlock.description: A quick-witted thief in Valor’s Call, Molliver gives most of their spoils to people in need. They often act first and count on friends to get them out of trouble.

sections.Traits:
Evasion. If a Dexterity save would allow half damage, Molliver takes none on a success and half on a failure. This ability does not work while incapacitated.
Special Equipment. Molliver wears +1 Leather Armor and Boots of Levitation.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Dagger and Shortsword.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. Add 7 (2d6) piercing damage if Molliver has advantage on the attack or the target is within 5 ft. of one of Molliver’s allies.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, one creature within reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Add 7 (2d6) piercing damage if Molliver has advantage on the attack or the target is within 5 ft. of one of Molliver’s allies.
Levitate. As an action while wearing the Boots of Levitation, cast Levitate on Molliver only.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. Molliver takes half the damage from one attack if they can see the attacker.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 226.
